sessionStart.powershell: & { $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"; try { $root = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; $legionHome = if ($env:LEGION_HOME) { $env:LEGION_HOME } else { $env:USERPROFILE }; if (!$root -or !$legionHome) { throw "Legion root missing" }; $versions = [regex]::Matches([IO.File]::ReadAllText("$root/plugin.json"), '(?m)^\s*"version"\s*:\s*"([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2}(-[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?(\+[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?)"'); if ($versions.Count -ne 1) { throw "Invalid Legion version" }; $version = $versions[0].Groups[1].Value; $name = [IO.File]::ReadAllText("$legionHome/.legion/app/$version/.legion-app-ready"); if ($name -cnotmatch "\Aenv-[0-9a-f]{12}(\r?\n)?\z") { throw "Invalid Legion environment" }; $python = "$legionHome/.legion/python/$($name.TrimEnd())/Scripts/python.exe"; & $python -I -B -S "$root/hooks/session_start.py" --home $legionHome --format context-json 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return } } catch { }; '{"additionalContext":"legion: uv or Python 3.12 is missing, so mode detection did not run; run the legion installer. If LEGION_ROLE=member is set, load the legion-member skill."}' }
